description: This file defines a template class StringTokenizerT for tokenizing strings with support for delimiters, quotes, and options. It includes examples and methods for token iteration.

classes.name: StringTokenizerT
classes.description: A template class for tokenizing strings with configurable delimiters, quotes, and options.

methods.name: set_options
methods.description: Sets options for the tokenizer, such as returning delimiters as tokens.

methods.name: set_quote_chars
methods.description: Sets quote characters to handle quoted substrings.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Advances the tokenizer to the next token or delimiter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the tokenizer to start from the beginning.

methods.name: token_is_delim
methods.description: Checks if the current token is a delimiter.

methods.name: token_begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the current token.

methods.name: token_end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the current token.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Returns the current token as a string.

methods.name: token_piece
methods.description: Returns a string view of the current token.
